annotation.title_clean: The IEEE-SA CertiFAIEd Ethics Certification Framework for Autonomous Intelligent Systems (AIS) Enabling Fully Integrated and Coordinated Ethical Implementations of AIS – An Illustration Through a Proposed Implementation of the IEEE7007-2021 Ontological Standard for Ethically Driven Robotics and Automation Systems
annotation.title_en: The IEEE-SA CertiFAIEd Ethics Certification Framework for Autonomous Intelligent Systems (AIS) Enabling Fully Integrated and Coordinated Ethical Implementations of AIS – An Illustration Through a Proposed Implementation of the IEEE7007-2021 Ontological Standard for Ethically Driven Robotics and Automation Systems
annotation.summary_en: Journal article introducing the IEEE-SA CertiFAIEd ethics certification framework for autonomous intelligent systems, with criteria suites for transparency, accountability, privacy, algorithmic bias and AI governance. It illustrates a proposed application to the IEEE 7007-2021 ontological standard for ethically driven robotics and automation systems.
key_provisions_or_claims: CertiFAIEd criteria cover transparency, accountability, privacy, algorithmic bias and, newly, governance of AI.
Requirements are normative or informative, assessed at low, medium or high impact levels, with evidence and scaled ratings.
Duty holders are regulators, developers, integrators, operators and maintainers; assessors and certifiers verify.
Framework can be adapted to IEEE 7007-2021 and other standards, policies and regulations.
Author is a certified assessor and writes independently of IEEE.
